about_the_game:
Zoria: Age of Shattering Bestiary is your comprehensive guide to the creatures and monsters that inhabit the diverse and dangerous world of Zoria.

This interactive compendium contains detailed descriptions, behaviors, strengths, and weaknesses of each creature you may encounter on your journey.

From the smallest critters to the most fearsome beasts like Wyrms and Izirian Warriors, the Bestiary provides invaluable information to help you strategize and prepare for battles
